Freezer Repairs from Serhan Refrigeration

Freezer faults rarely wait for a convenient time. We prioritise urgent callouts and aim to fix the problem on the first visit wherever possible.

  • Urgent callouts for freezer failures

Privacy Policy

How Serhan Refrigeration handles your personal information.

Serhan Refrigeration Pty Ltd is committed to protecting your privacy. This policy explains how we collect, use and protect the information you give us.

Information We Collect

When you request a quote or service, we may collect your name, phone number, email address and details about the work you need.

How We Use It

We use your information only to respond to your enquiry, provide quotes, schedule work and communicate with you about our services. We do not sell your information.

Terms & Conditions

The terms that apply when you engage Serhan Refrigeration.

By engaging Serhan Refrigeration Pty Ltd for work, you agree to the following terms.

Quotes & Pricing

Quotes are free and valid for 30 days unless stated otherwise. Final pricing may change if site conditions differ from what was assessed.

Scheduling

We make every reasonable effort to attend on time. Emergency callouts are prioritised by urgency and availability.

Warranty

Workmanship is warranted for the period stated on your quote or invoice. Manufacturer warranties apply separately to supplied equipment.

Payment

Payment is due on completion of work unless other terms are agreed in writing, such as under a maintenance contract.

Contact

Questions about these terms? Please contact us.
